findings.detail: The output claims indexed transcript lines 1–3657 were read. The authenticated execution contains no transcript-content read call and returns zero complete indexed-source lines before the final submission. Counting transcript lines with wc is not reading its content.

Only packet lines 1–400 were read directly. Subsequent packet and inventory projections omit fields and contain truncated aggregates; no later call retrieves the omitted material. The required complete inventory and anonymous packet cannot be authenticated.
The standalone library was read only at lines 1–240 and 880–1040, not completely as required by the frozen instructions.

editorialDisposition: All 28 resolutions and supplied alternatives were inspected, but schema validity and plausible rationales do not cure the execution failure. No resolution is accepted for scoring.
